name: Al Khaleej Takaful Insurance Company Q.P.S.C.
summary: Al Khaleej Takaful Insurance Company Q.P.S.C., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the insurance, reinsurance, and takaful insurance businesses for individuals and corporates in Qatar. It operates through Takaful, Investment, and Real Estate segments. The company offers comprehensive and third-party insurance products; and property insurance products, such as fire and special perils, property all risks, business interruption, terrorism, and jewelers block insurance.
